description: This PHP source file defines the MembershipMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. Its purpose is to configure menu items related to the 'membership' screen within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. The class uses a trait for module screen helpers and overrides the screen to 'membership' when the configure method is called.

classes.name: MembershipMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures admin menu for the 'membership' screen, overriding the current screen to 'membership'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'membership' using a helper method and returns null.
